about.title: ABOUT US
about.h1: MORE THAN 30 YEARS OF TRADITION AND
about.p1: URVIS Razlakiranje Kovin D.O.O. was founded with a clear vision: to offer premium cleaning and stripping services for metal components to Slovenian and European industry, while strictly adhering to environmental standards.
about.p2: Using state-of-the-art technologies such as the Dinamec and TD machines, we provide our partners with fast, efficient and safe removal of all types of industrial coatings.
about.mission: Our mission is to extend the lifespan of industrial equipment and enable the reuse of components with the highest precision.

tech.title: ADVANCED TECHNOLOGIES
tech.sub: 3 process lines, precise temperature control and ecological stabilisation.
tech.d_desc: A state-of-the-art machine for thermal cleaning, operating on the principle of a fluidised quartz sand bed. The system completely removes paint, plastic and other organic coatings from metal parts without damaging the structure.
tech.td_desc: Designed for processing temperature-sensitive materials. The gentler thermal profile ensures that aluminium, zinc and thin metals remain dimensionally stable without bending or deformation.
tech.s_desc: The process of thermal stabilisation of waste powder paint generated in filters and cyclone systems during powder coating. The result is an industrially stable waste that can be safely disposed of.

razlak.title: METAL STRIPPING
razlak.sub: Professional removal of paints, lacquers and coatings without damage to the base material.
razlak.why_desc: The thermal process (pyrolysis) allows thorough cleaning of even the most inaccessible areas without mechanical damage, chemicals or water.

stab.title: POWDER PAINT STABILISATION
stab.sub: Responsible waste management. We convert hazardous powder paint into a stable residue.
stab.intro: The powder coating industry generates significant quantities of waste paint (from dust extraction, filters, cyclones), which is often classified as reactive and hazardous waste. Our thermal stabilisation process solves this problem at source.
stab.p1_d: Controlled solidification (polymerisation) of the powder into a solid material without moisture.
stab.p2_d: Prevents the risk of dust explosion during transport and disposal.
stab.p3_d: Meets all strict environmental and municipal regulations in Slovenia and the EU.
